title: Generation of Vascularized Human Cardiac Organoids for 3D In Vitro Modeling
author: Voges, Mills, et al.
materials:
Timing: 6 h
25.Prepare stock reagents in a biosafety cabinet using aseptic technique. Ahead of time, ensure that 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and 0.2mL PCR tubes have been sterilized.26.L-ascorbic acid 2 phosphate (AA2P):a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 200 mM in milli-Q water.i.E.g., Add 43.15 mL milli-Q water to 2.5 g stock and mix well.c.Filter sterilize into 50 mL conical tube.d.Prepare 500 μL aliquots in sterilized 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.e.Store at −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 12 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability.
27.Human Bone Morphogenetic Protein 4 (BMP4):a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 500 μg/mL in 4 mM hydrochloric acid.i.E.g., add 100 μL 4 mM Hydrochloric acid to 50 μg BMP4.c.Dilute this solution in 0.1% (w/v) bovine serum albumin (BSA) in milli-Q water to 20 μg/mL.d.Prepare 50 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.e.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store at −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
28.Human Activin-A:a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 36 μg/mL in 0.1% (w/v) BSA in PBS.i.E.g., Add 1.38 mL of 0.1% BSA in PBS to 50 μg stock and mix well.c.Prepare 50 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.d.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. Thawed reagents are stable at 4°C for 1 month.
29.Human basic fibroblast growth factor (FGF-2):a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 20 μg/mL in 0.1% (w/v) BSA in PBS.c.E.g., Add 1.25 mL 0.1% BSA in PBS to 25 μg stock and mix well.d.Prepare 50 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.e.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
30.CHIR99021.a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 10 mM in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO).i.E.g., Add 2.15 mL DMSO to 10 mg stock and mix well.c.Prepare 20 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.d.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
31.IWP-4:a.Quick spin the vial to ensure no product is lost.b.Reconstitute vial to 5 mM in DMSO.i.E.g., Add 4.03 mL DMSO to 10 mg stock and mix well.c.May require a freeze-thaw and mixing at 37°C to properly get into solution.d.Prepare 50 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.e.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Another freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
32.Human platelet-derived growth factor BB (PDGF-BB):a.Reconstitute vial to 20 μg/mL in 0.1% BSA in PBS.i.E.g., Add 2.5 mL 0.1% BSA in PBS to 50 μg PDGF-BB.b.Filter sterilize solution into 50 mL tube.c.Prepare 20μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.d.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 3 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
33.Insulin, human recombinant:a.Stock vial comes at 4 mg/mL in zinc solution.b.Prepare 2–5 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.c.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 12 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. For use, dilute insulin 1:500 in DMEM and use this fresh in weaning medium.
34.B-27 supplement (both with and without insulin):a.Thaw stock 10 mL supplement bottles at room temperature (15°C–25°C).b.Aliquot supplements into 1 mL aliquots in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.c.Store at −20°C. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. Thaw aliquot immediately before use.35.Palmitic acid:a.Reconstitute vial to 0.1 M in DMSO.i.E.g., Add 19.4 mL DMSO to 500 mg Palmitic acid.b.Prepare 100 μL aliquots in sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.c.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 12 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. We keep thawed reagents at 4°C for 1 week maximum.
36.D-glucose at 1 M:a.Reconstitute D-glucose to 1 M in milli-Q water.i.E.g., Add 50 mL milli-Q water to 9 g D-glucose.b.Filter sterilize solution into 50 mL conical tube.c.Store at 4°C for up to 3 months.37.Aprotinin:a.Reconstitute vial to 33 mg/mL in PBS.i.E.g., Add 15.1 mL PBS to 500 mg stock.b.Aliquot stock solution in 50 μL into sterilized 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.c.Transfer PCR tubes to 50 mL conical tube and store −20°C.
Note: A aliquots are stable when stored at −80°C for 6 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. Use on day of thaw.
38.Collagenase I:a.Make up 20% fetal bovine serum (FBS) in PBS with calcium and magnesium (+/+).i.E.g., Add 10 mL FBS to 40 mL PBS (+/+).b.Reconstitute collagenase I to 0.2% (w/v).i.E.g., Add 50 mL 20% FBS in PBS to 100 mg of collagenase I.c.Filter sterilize solution into 50 mL conical tube.d.Aliquot stock solution in 5 mL into 15 mL conical tubes.e.Store at −20°C.
Note: Aliquots are stable when stored at −20°C for 12 months. Freeze thaw is not recommended for product stability. Use on the day of thaw.
Note: Occasionally the concentration of the collagenase I needs to be adjusted based on the enzymatic activity of a particular batch.
39.3% bovine serum albumin (BSA):a.Make up 3% BSA in PBS.i.E.g., weigh 3 g in 100 mL PBS.b.Filter sterilize solution into 50 mL tube.c.Store at 4°C for up to 1 month.40.DMEM for organoids:a.Make up 10X DMEM in milli-Q water.i.E.g., Weigh 1.996 g of DMEM powder.ii.Add 740 mg NaHCO3.iii.Re-suspend in 20mL milli-Q water.iv.Heat solution at 37°C to help dissolve the solution.b.Adjust pH to 7.2.c.Filter sterilize solution into 50 mL tube.d.Store at 4°C for up to 1 month.41.NaOH for organoids:a.Make up 0.1 M NaOH in milli-Q water.i.E.g., Add 187.5 mg to 43.7 mL milli-Q water.ii.Re-suspend solution.b.Filter sterilize solution into a sterile 50 mL conical tube.c.Store at 4°C for up to 1 month.42.Conjugation of Palmitate to B27 supplement, minus insulin:a.Heat 2 × 1 mL aliquots of B27- and 1 × 100 μL aliquot of palmitate in water bath at 37°C.b.Once warm, add 25 μL of warmed palmitate to each 1 mL B27- aliquot.Note: Aliquots should be completely thawed and warmed before addition or the palmitate will not go into solution.c.Shake at 37°C for 2 h at 1250x RPM covered with aluminum foil.Note: Solution should be clear with no precipitate to indicate proper conjugation.d.Add conjugated B27- to maturation medium (described below) immediately, or store at 4°C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel coated plates
steps.instruction: Thaw, aliquot, dilute, and coat T25 flasks with Matrigel, then incubate before use.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a 10 mL bottle of LDEV‑Free Matrigel on ice for 6 h.
Aliquot 500 µL of Matrigel on ice into sterile Eppendorf tubes and store at –20 °C until needed.
Thaw an aliquot on ice for 1 h until liquid.
Aliquot 49.5 mL PBS (minus Mg²⁺/Ca²⁺) on ice; keep PBS pre‑chilled.
Dilute Matrigel 1:50 (v/v) by adding 500 µL Matrigel to the ice‑cold PBS (follow manufacturer’s instructions).
Rinse the original Eppendorf tube with PBS to transfer the entire Matrigel volume.
Coat each T25 flask with 2.5 mL of the Matrigel working solution.
Leave coated flasks in the biosafety cabinet for at least 1 h (or incubate at 37 °C for ≥30 min, or pre‑coat the night before and store at 4 °C).
Maintain Matrigel on ice/4 °C at all times to prevent premature gelation.
When scaling to other vessel sizes, keep the surface‑area‑to‑volume ratio constant.
If a Matrigel batch has a different concentration, adjust the dilution according to the product data sheet.

steps.title: Make AA2P stock solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 200 mM L‑ascorbic acid‑2‑phosphate stock, filter‑sterilize, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the AA2P vial.
Reconstitute to 200 mM by adding 43.15 mL milli‑Q water to 2.5 g powder; mix well.
Filter‑sterilize the solution into a 50 mL conical tube.
Aliquot 500 µL into sterilized 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Store aliquots at –20 °C (stable 12 months; avoid freeze‑thaw).

steps.title: Make BMP4 stock
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 µg/mL BMP4 in 4 mM HCl, dilute to 20 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the BMP4 vial.
Reconstitute to 500 µg/mL by adding 100 µL 4 mM HCl to 50 µg BMP4.
Dilute this solution with 0.1 % (w/v) BSA in milli‑Q water to a final concentration of 20 µg/mL.
Aliquot 50 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare Activin‑A stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute Activin‑A to 36 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA/PBS, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the Activin‑A vial.
Reconstitute to 36 µg/mL by adding 1.38 mL 0.1 % BSA in PBS to 50 µg powder; mix well.
Aliquot 50 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; thawed stable at 4 °C 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare FGF‑2 stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute basic fibroblast growth factor to 20 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA/PBS, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the FGF‑2 vial.
Reconstitute to 20 µg/mL by adding 1.25 mL 0.1 % BSA in PBS to 25 µg powder; mix well.
Aliquot 50 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare CHIR99021 stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute CHIR99021 to 10 mM in DMSO, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the CHIR99021 vial.
Reconstitute to 10 mM by adding 2.15 mL DMSO to 10 mg powder; mix well.
Aliquot 20 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Make IWP‑4 stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute IWP‑4 to 5 mM in DMSO, optionally heat, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Quick‑spin the IWP‑4 vial.
Reconstitute to 5 mM by adding 4.03 mL DMSO to 10 mg powder; mix well.
If needed, perform a freeze‑thaw cycle and incubate at 37 °C to fully dissolve.
Aliquot 50 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare PDGF‑BB stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute PDGF‑BB to 20 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA/PBS, filter, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute PDGF‑BB vial to 20 µg/mL by adding 2.5 mL 0.1 % BSA in PBS to 50 µg powder.
Filter‑sterilize the solution into a 50 mL tube.
Aliquot 20 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 3 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Aliquot insulin stock
steps.instruction: Dispense insulin from 4 mg/mL zinc stock into small aliquots and store.

substeps.instruction: From the 4 mg/mL insulin vial, pipette 2–5 µL aliquots into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 12 months; avoid freeze‑thaw).
For use, dilute insulin 1:500 in DMEM fresh in the weaning medium.

steps.title: Prepare B‑27 supplement aliquots
steps.instruction: Thaw B‑27 (with or without insulin), aliquot, and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a 10 mL bottle of B‑27 at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C).
Aliquot 1 mL portions into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Store aliquots at –20 °C; do not freeze‑thaw repeatedly.
Thaw an aliquot immediately before use.

steps.title: Make palmitic acid stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve palmitic acid to 0.1 M in DMSO, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute by adding 19.4 mL DMSO to 500 mg palmitic acid; mix to 0.1 M.
Aliquot 100 µL into sterilized 0.2 mL PCR tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –20 °C (stable 12 months; keep thawed at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare 1 M glucose stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve glucose to 1 M, filter, and store at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL milli‑Q water to 9 g D‑glucose; mix.
Filter‑sterilize into a 50 mL conical tube.
Store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

steps.title: Make aprotinin stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute aprotinin to 33 mg/mL in PBS, aliquot and store at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add 15.1 mL PBS to 500 mg aprotinin powder (final 33 mg/mL).
Aliquot 50 µL into sterilized 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Transfer PCR tubes to a 50 mL conical tube and store at –80 °C (stable 6 months; use on day of thaw).

steps.title: Prepare collagenase I stock
steps.instruction: Make 20 % FBS/PBS, reconstitute collagenase I to 0.2 % w/v, filter, aliquot and store.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 20 % FBS in PBS (+/+): add 10 mL FBS to 40 mL PBS containing Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺.
Reconstitute collagenase I to 0.2 % w/v by adding 100 mg collagenase I to 50 mL of the 20 % FBS/PBS solution.
Filter‑sterilize the mixture into a 50 mL conical tube.
Aliquot 5 mL into 15 mL conical tubes.
Store at –20 °C (stable 12 months; use on day of thaw; adjust concentration if batch activity varies).

steps.title: Make 3 % BSA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve BSA to 3 % w/v in PBS, filter and store.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 3 g BSA and dissolve in 100 mL PBS.
Filter‑sterilize into a 50 mL tube.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare 10X DMEM stock
steps.instruction: Combine DMEM powder, NaHCO₃, dissolve, adjust pH, filter and store.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 1.996 g DMEM powder and 740 mg NaHCO₃.
Resuspend in 20 mL milli‑Q water.
Heat at 37 °C to aid dissolution.
Adjust pH to 7.2.
Filter‑sterilize into a 50 mL tube.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M NaOH stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve NaOH to 0.1 M, filter and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 187.5 mg NaOH to 43.7 mL milli‑Q water; mix.
Filter‑sterilize into a sterile 50 mL conical tube.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Conjugate palmitate to B‑27‑minus insulin
steps.instruction: Heat B‑27 and palmitate aliquots, combine, shake, and store or use immediately.

substeps.instruction: Heat two 1 mL B‑27‑minus‑insulin aliquots and one 100 µL palmitate aliquot in a 37 °C water bath until fully thawed.
Add 25 µL warmed palmitate to each 1 mL B‑27 aliquot.
Shake the mixture at 37 °C, 1250 rpm for 2 h, covered with aluminum foil.
Confirm the solution is clear with no precipitate (successful conjugation).
Add the conjugated B‑27‑minus‑insulin directly to the maturation medium, or store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Set up microscope for force imaging
steps.instruction: Power on microscope with 4× objective, CO₂ and temperature control, and wait for stabilization.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the microscope, ensure the 4× objective is installed, and activate CO₂ and temperature regulation.
Verify the automated stage controller (e.g., Leica Thunder) and LAS X software are connected.
Allow temperature and CO₂ to reach set points before starting acquisition.

steps.title: Define acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Select organoids, focus on pole, set ROI and recording settings.

substeps.instruction: Create acquisition points for each organoid.
Using software, focus the Z‑axis on the top of the organoid pole.
Draw a square ROI around the organoid (low magnification 4× captures the whole organoid).
Set acquisition to record 500 frames over 10 s (50 fps) in bright‑field mode.

steps.title: Export and convert image files
steps.instruction: Save multipage TIFs with sequential names, then batch‑convert to AVI using MATLAB.

substeps.instruction: Export the recorded sequence as multipage TIF files named 001, 002, … (≈250 MB each).
Run the MATLAB script “TIF2AVI” to batch‑convert TIFs to AVI files (≈10 MB each).
Ensure the required MATLAB toolboxes are installed: Signal Processing, Computer Vision, Statistics and Machine Learning, Image Processing, Image Acquisition, Bioinformatics.

steps.title: Configure MATLAB analysis
steps.instruction: Load the first AVI, set ROI, and propagate coordinates to analysis scripts.

substeps.instruction: Open the MATLAB script “SettingConditions” and replace line 3 with the filename ‘001.avi’.
Run the script to generate ROI coordinates for the left‑hand pillar.
Copy the ROI coordinates into the “poletracking” script.
If needed, adjust “minpeakheight” and “minpeakdistance” parameters to suit the dataset.

steps.title: Run batch force analysis
steps.instruction: Execute batchanalysis script, review outputs, and apply exclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Save any changes to the poletracking script.
Run the MATLAB script “batchanalysis”.
The script creates a JPG image per video and an Excel sheet with force, rate, contraction/relaxation times.
Inspect each generated graph to confirm correct peak detection; discard any video with mis‑assigned peaks.
Exclude organoids from analysis if the tissue or pole is broken, deformed, not condensed, or has detached from the pole.

description: Before using the methods described in this protocol, it is essential that the users obtain relevant ethical approval for the culture of human pluripotent stem cell lines. Also note that this protocol is optimized for feeder-free pluripotent stem cell culture, so adaptation of pluripotent stem cell lines may be required. SU-8 wafer manufactured in a fabrication facility is required before you begin. Computer-aided design (CAD) file attached.
